concerns.text: Tasks T017 (data split) and T018 (evaluation) introduce a training/test split and evaluate only on the test set. FR‑006 explicitly requires scoring **all** gene‑pair correlation scores (full, imbalanced set) against STRING. This narrows the evaluation scope without a spec‑approved staging mechanism, violating the ‘no retroactive narrowing’ rule.

The verification step for T023 checks only monotonicity of AUROC/AUPRC. FR‑025 also mandates that the per‑threshold **edge count** (`num_edges`) be recorded. The current verification does not assert the presence or correctness of this column, risking a dropped acceptance criterion.
